I built a personalized signal play for ZEDEDA off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Peter, quick follow-up for ZEDEDA.

With a GTC launch and new partners, demand across edge AI tends to outrun what the BD team can work. Most groups cannot say how many meetings they need to convert that interest into pipeline, so the gap shows up late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ZEDEDA needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
